title: John Calvin
source: Public domain. Consolidated from John Calvin, Commentary on the Epistles to Timothy, Titus, and Philemon, translated by William Pringle, Calvin Translation Society, and the Institutes of the Christian Religion, translated by Henry Beveridge; both as published by the Christian Classics Ethereal Library.
body: John Calvin on Titus, chapter 3. In his Commentary on the Epistles to Timothy, Titus, and Philemon, in the William Pringle translation, Calvin writes at Titus 3, verse 1: Remind them to be subject to principalities and powers From many passages it is evident that the Apostles had great difficulty in keeping the common people subject to the authority of magistrates and princes. In the Institutes of the Christian Religion, in the Henry Beveridge translation, Calvin draws on this chapter again in Book 4, chapter 15.
